2126318724428730598.en_summary: (Reposted by @BarbarianCap) I spent time reading Lab researcher / Hyperscaler expert calls on Tegus and building an AI industry GW + ANT model. Conclusion: 2027 is going to get pretty crazy. Didn’t wrap head around just how much $ANT is going to be spending on training. Market reacted to how little ANT was spending on serving vs training with ~25% split. Base case: ANT spend ~6x more on training/RL models by end of ‘27 vs current / Opus 5.5 class, closer to 10x effective with efficiency gains. Extreme excitement about what 10x more effective compute to train models by end of ‘27 could mean. Researchers still have insatiable demand for compute. Semi’s more long the frontier than thought because inference is less GW than thought.
2126318724428730598.zh_summary: （由 @BarbarianCap 轉發）我花了些時間閱讀Tegus上的實驗室研究員/超大規模專家電話，並建立AI行業GW + ANT模型。結論：2027年將變得相當瘋狂。沒有完全理解 $ANT 將在訓練上花費多少。市場對ANT在服務與訓練上的支出（約25%分割）反應。基礎情況：ANT到‘27年底在訓練/RL模型上的支出約為當前/Opus 5.5類的6倍，考慮效率提升可能接近10倍有效。對到‘27年底10倍有效算力訓練模型的含義極度興奮。研究員對算力仍有無止境需求。半導體比想像中更看好前沿，因為推理GW比想像中少。

ticker_notes.ANT: 到2027年底訓練支出可能6-10倍，前沿需求強
